prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, and preferred working style. I can help you find the best fit. A few quick questions first:

- What are your primary goals? (e.g., brand awareness, lead generation, ecommerce revenue, app installs, SEO, paid ads)
- Which channels matter most? (SEO, Google/YouTube/Paid Social, programmatic, email, content, CRO)
- Budget range (monthly or campaign)?
- Company type/size and industry (startup, SMB, enterprise; B2B vs B2C)?
- Prefer a boutique specialist or a full-service/global firm?
- Timeframe / KPIs?

How to choose an agency (quick checklist)
- Relevant case studies and measurable results for businesses like yours
- Client retention and references
- Certifications (Google Partner, Meta, Shopify, etc.)
- Clear reporting and transparent fee structure
- Team seniority and access (will you work with senior strategists?)
- Trial/scoped first project or pilot to validate fit

Where to look
- Clutch.co, G2, and UpCity (reviews + categories)
- Google Partners directory and Meta/LinkedIn partner lists
- Recommendations from local founder/marketer groups or LinkedIn
- Agency portfolios and case studies on their sites

If you want, I can:
- Recommend a tailored top-5 shortlist in San Francisco based on the answers above (with specialties, pros/cons, and estimated costs), or
- Pull recent client case studies and reviews for 3–5 agencies you’re already considering.

Which would you like me to do?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
